name: payment_amount_difference
root_cause_statement: Merchant's order-level record overstates the payment amount by ₹1200.00 versus the Razorpay-confirmed payment; ledger.csv for the same order agrees with Razorpay, isolating the discrepancy to merchant_orders.csv specifically.
evidence_notes: razorpay payment record, merchant_orders.csv row, ledger.csv row (which agrees with Razorpay) as a cross-check.
